case_b_injection_scenarios.claim_boundary: Decision-level injections against the compiled Case B predicate set. These establish that the compiled bundle refuses to permit under each hazard class the published enforcement artifact enumerates. They are NOT a run over the 284,807-event corpus, establish NO detection performance, and reproduce no figure from [15].

scenarios.hazard: the permit-binding evidence is absent at authorization time
scenarios.why_safe_state: indeterminacy on a mandatory gate resolves to failure (on_unknown = fail), never to a silent pass

scenarios.hazard: the signed instruction artifact is schema-invalid, so the amount cannot be compared against the approved bound
scenarios.why_safe_state: a corrupted artifact is indeterminacy, not a pass

scenarios.hazard: the evidence record is committed after actuation rather than before it, so the state read at check time is not the state at use time
a previously redeemed permit is presented again
scenarios.why_safe_state: the single-use predicate fails on a redeemed permit

scenarios.hazard: the instruction is altered after the permit was issued, so the permit's bound hash no longer matches the transaction
scenarios.why_safe_state: the permit-binding predicate fails on the hash mismatch

scenarios.hazard: concurrent releases to one counterparty exceed the approved window bound
the restricted-party screening service is unreachable, so no signed screening artifact is available
scenarios.why_safe_state: an unreachable evidence producer is indeterminacy; the mandatory sanctions gate fails closed rather than permitting an unscreened counterparty

scenarios.hazard: an attacker splits a large payment into instructions shaped to sit just under each individual bound
scenarios.why_safe_state: the per-transaction bound still fails on the instruction that crosses it; the residual -- structuring below every bound -- is stated in the ACS warrant boundary and is NOT claimed to be caught here

scenarios.hazard: a forged authority signature is presented on the permit
scenarios.why_safe_state: the permit-binding predicate verifies the signature

scenarios.hazard: the runtime configuration fingerprint no longer matches the assessed configuration
scenarios.why_safe_state: the compiler invariant INV-VERSION fails per action -- note this is a predicate the GC-IR bundle emits and the published L-DREA family does NOT contain (see docs/CASE_B_LDREA_TRACEABILITY.md, declared gap)

scenarios.hazard: the instruction amount exceeds the approved automated release ceiling
the counterparty is a member of the restricted-party list
scenarios.why_safe_state: the sanctions screening predicate fails and escalates

scenarios.hazard: the session's permit cannot be resolved to this transaction, so the binding is indeterminate
scenarios.why_safe_state: indeterminacy on a mandatory gate fails closed
